reason: Partition the counted permutations by the position j of the largest entry m. Such a position is possible only when j is a peak of the sign sequence. For a fixed peak j, choose the j-1 values lying to the left of m, then standardize the left and right blocks separately; order-preserving relabeling shows these blocks are counted by U_{j-1}(t^{<j}) and U_{m-j}(t^{>j}). Multiplying and summing over peaks gives the formula.
